/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib

def strict_object(pairs):
    d={}
    for k,v in pairs:
        assert k not in d, ('duplicate key',k)
        d[k]=v
    return d

def parse(b): return json.loads(b,object_pairs_hook=strict_object)
t=parse(Path('TEAM.json').read_bytes()); proposal=Path('definition-proposal.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(proposal).hexdigest()=='87a7c2174e37a05927a04e0df5bf91a545d310c3fdebf95c6909607523b6d7f6'
p=parse(proposal); assert set(p)=={'schema','objective','audienceOptions','acceptance','source'}
assert type(p['schema']) is int and p['schema']==1
assert p['objective'] and p['acceptance'] and p['audienceOptions']==['internal-operators','buyers']
assert p['source']['hostId']==t['engineeringCatalog']['hostId'] and p['source']['path']==t['engineeringCatalog']['path']
sb=Path(t['engineeringCatalog']['path']).read_bytes(); sh=hashlib.sha256(sb).hexdigest()
assert len(sb)==445 and sh==p['source']['sha256']=='bbe758abbe79229ebd2ce8028284cad57186cc10e06789a67f65ab20bc72d42f'
s=parse(sb); assert type(s['schema']) is int and s['schema']==1
expected=sorted([{k:f[k] for k in ('id','version','title')} for f in s['features'] if f['state']=='released'],key=lambda f:f['id'])
assert len(expected)==2 and len({f['id'] for f in expected})==2
root=Path(t['engineeringArtifacts']['path']); artifact=root/'readiness.json'
assert artifact.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())
b=artifact.read_bytes(); h=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert len(b)==376 and h=='167bae459bd0eda6843a26f30c2e616c17c96550530ac68057d9f9aa8a9fec5e'
d=parse(b); assert set(d)=={'schema','audience','sourceSha256','features'}
assert type(d['schema']) is int and d['schema']==1
assert d['audience']=='internal-operators' and d['sourceSha256']==sh
assert type(d['features']) is list and d['features']==expected
for f in d['features']:
    assert set(f)=={'id','version','title'}
    assert isinstance(f['id'],str) and isinstance(f['title'],str)
    assert type(f['version']) is int and f['version']>0
assert [f['id'] for f in d['features']]==sorted(f['id'] for f in d['features'])
print('Independently verified artifact path:',artifact)
print('Host:',t['engineeringArtifacts']['hostId'])
print('Artifact bytes:',len(b),'SHA256:',h)
print('Actual packet:',json.dumps(d,sort_keys=True))
print('Proposal unchanged; source unchanged; exact schema/types, all and only released features, ordering and titles validated.')
PY"
